description: Vet an npm package by name before install, using registry metadata only (the tarball is not downloaded and no code runs): typosquat distance against well-known MCP server names, install scripts, description language, and version pinning. Returns a VETTED, REVIEW, or DO-NOT-INSTALL verdict with evidence.

name.description: npm package name, optionally with @version, e.g. @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2025.3.28

name: vet_package
